metadata.title: kthvalue incorrect with strided GPU tensor

bug_description:
## 🐛 Bug



When input tensor is on GPU and is strided, `kthvalue` will give wrong values and indices.

trigger_conditions.condition: Applying tensor operators on non-contiguous tensors generated by slicing, transpose, or stride-changing operations, and checking whether results match contiguous tensor semantics.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: Input tensor is on CUDA and has a non-contiguous strided layout, e.g., created by slicing with a step greater than 1 such as tensor[::2].

failure_behavior.description: Input tensor is on CUDA and has a non-contiguous strided layout, e.g., created by slicing with a step greater than 1 such as tensor[::2].
